summary: Preserve the Tock attach-mode path that clicks exact-time search-result Book rows before broad experience-card links.
reason: Some Tock venues expose requested availability through the /search result list while the venue and experience pages still show generic experience-card Book now links. Clicking those card links first resets the date/time query and prevents the checkout transition for the requested slot.
validated_outcome: Unit coverage pins that the Tock driver opens the search-result path, clicks the matching exact-time Book row, and avoids the broader experience-card link.
